card.name: Digits in list markers and citations
card.fires_on: Single digits or letters that label the first item in an enumerated list such as "1)" or "(a)" after a colon. Also digits inside journal volume and page numbers in reference lists.

modes.label: List openers
modes.description: The "1" or "a" that starts a numbered or lettered list after a colon or lead-in phrase.
modes.example: The management of NMS should include: <<1>>) intensive symptomatic treatment and medical monitoring

modes.label: Citation numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a volume, year or page number in a reference entry.
modes.example: Alcohol and breast cancer in women: a pooled analysis of cohort studies. JAMA, 1998. 2<<7>>9: p. 535

card.plain: It marks the number or letter that begins an enumerated list, and digits inside reference citations.
